title: HARMONIC ATLAS
tagline: Find a chord. Follow a melody. Keep a little world.
help: Lock Harmony, Melody or Rhythm before New song to preserve that part. Chord voices move between nearby notes; melodies reuse a motif across an arranged sixteen-bar performance. Sound worlds change instruments and harmony color. The quiet Glass harbor world leaves space around the notes.
seeds: Three independent 32-bit seeds guide harmony, melody and rhythm. Different codes can produce related music.
